jobs.description:
Director of Data & AI
This role reports to the Chief Product Officer (CPO).

Remote within Sweden

Some travel, under about ten days a quarter 
Every business aviation trip starts with someone needing to be somewhere. Thousands of brokers and operators use Avinode to turn that need into a flight, and every request, quote, and booking they make is a signal nobody else holds. 
Data has been a key product and strategy differentiator in the software industry for years. In the AI era, the importance of clean, timely, and accurate data only accelerates. AI drives efficiency for our customers and our business, but unless it is powered by a solid data foundation, its convincing conclusions risk taking us in the wrong direction, faster. 
Data & AI is a company-wide concern, but to create focus and accountability on the foundations that serve the rest of the company and the product, we are bringing the necessary competencies – starting with data product management, engineering, and analytics – together as one team. This role is about leading that team, and we're looking for real depth in the space, not just general leadership.

What you’ll do

You’ll ensure the delivery of governed data products built around Databricks and its suite of tools.

You’ll make sure entities and metrics have a single agreed-upon human- and agentreadable meaning regardless of their source.

You’ll put models and governed, evaluated agents into production, with accuracy and cost you can prove.

You’ll lead a team consisting of a product manager, analysts, and an engineering team with its own manager.

You’ll grow the team – both in size and capabilities. We’re investing in this fast-evolving space, giving you the opportunity to help shape the team to meet upcoming competence needs.

You’ll have strategic and operational responsibility for the new Data & AI function, where you’ll contribute with a strong voice in shaping the company-level direction.

You’ll make sure your team and the company understand the strategy, priorities, decisions, and expected outcomes.

Who you are

You have 10+ years of experience in data product, engineering, or analytics.

You have a 6+ year track record of building capable, high-performing teams and helping people grow through clear expectations, feedback, and coaching.

You communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non-technical audiences, adapting your message to the audience and context.

You can explain technical priorities, trade-offs, risks, and decisions in terms that support business decisions.

You're still close enough to the work to hold technical direction. This matters more to us than the size of the team you last ran.

You've done at least two of these three properly, and you're literate in the third: - Built a governed semantic or metric layer that people actually trusted, across systems that didn't agree. - Put ML models into production and kept them working. - Shipped LLM or agent systems into production, with evaluation, cost control, and latency as first-class concerns.

Nice-to-haves

Hands-on experience with Databricks in production.

A marketplace, two-sided platform, or another business where the data is the moat.

Experience being an early senior data or AI leader somewhere. 

What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.
· Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. · Competitive salary and benefits · Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well   as having fun which is equally as important. · Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings.    We want to support your development and dreams.
Want to join our crew? Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.occupation: Document Controller – Data Center Project in Borlänge
jobs.description:
Barona är ett autoriserat rekrytering- och bemanningsföretag som verkar inom flera affärsområden i hela Sverige. Genom bemanning, rekrytering och outsourcing hjälper vi företag att säkra rätt kompetens, samtidigt som vi skapar långsiktiga möjligheter för människor i arbetslivet.
Barona grundades i Helsingfors, Finland 1999.
Location: Borlänge
Employment type: 6-month project-based employment
Start: As soon as possible
On behalf of our client, we are looking for a Document Controller in Borlänge who is interested in developing their skills within document and information management while working on a large-scale technical project.
In this role, you will be an important part of the project team, helping to ensure that drawings, technical documentation and other project information are up to date, correctly structured and available to the right people.
You will work closely with Project Managers, Design Managers, technical specialists, subcontractors and other stakeholders involved in the project.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is structured, detail-oriented and interested in developing their skills while working on a major technical data center project.
About the role
As a Document Controller, you will help create structure and maintain control of the project's documentation and information.
Your responsibilities will include:
Registering, organising and updating project documentation.
Ensuring that documents and drawings are stored correctly and in accordance with project procedures.
Managing document numbers, metadata, versions and revision status.
Updating and maintaining document registers.
Distributing documents and drawings to the relevant stakeholders.
Following up on documents awaiting review or approval.
Managing incoming and outgoing documentation.
Supporting the project team with documentation throughout the different phases of the project.
Assisting with documentation for commissioning and final handover.
Ensuring that documentation is accurate, traceable and up to date.

You will also interact with different parts of the project organisation and help ensure that the right information is available when needed.
Systems and digital document management
An important part of the role is managing documentation in various digital systems and project platforms.
These may include:
Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)
BIM 360
ProjectWise
SharePoint
Aconex
Microsoft Office

You do not need to have experience with all of these systems from the start. What matters most is that you have good computer skills, are comfortable working with digital tools and can quickly learn new systems and ways of working.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone with at least three years of relevant experience who is interested in continuing to develop within document and information management.
You may have previous experience in roles such as:
Document Controller
Project Documentation Coordinator
Project Administrator
Technical Administrator
Project Coordinator
Administrator within construction, installation, industrial or technical projects

Previous experience within construction, installation, data centers, infrastructure, industry or energy is an advantage, but not a requirement.
To succeed in this role, we believe that you
Are accurate, organised and structured.
Enjoy creating order and have a strong eye for detail.
Are comfortable handling large volumes of information and documentation.
Have good computer and system skills.
Have good knowledge of Microsoft Office.
Are able to quickly learn new digital systems.
Have good communication skills and enjoy working with others.
Can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.
Are solution-oriented and comfortable asking questions when something is unclear.
Can prioritise between different tasks in a fast-paced project environment.

Knowledge of document management, technical drawings, quality management systems or ISO 19650 is an advantage, but not a requirement.
Language skills
As you will be working in an international project environment, you need to be able to communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.
Knowledge of Swedish is highly desirable, and additional Nordic languages are considered an advantage.
Take the next step
Above all, we are looking for the right person with the right attitude. You do not need to know everything from day one.
Your attention to detail, organisational skills, curiosity and willingness to learn are just as important as extensive work experience.
If you want to continue developing in an administrative role while gaining experience from a large-scale technical project in Borlänge, we would like to hear from you.
Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position may be filled before the closing date.
For questions about the position, please contact:
Camilla Arvidsson
0735-40 27 96

Good product data helps good products do their job
Our Product Information Management (PIM) team ensures that customers, partners and colleagues can find accurate, consistent product information wherever they need it. We use Inriver as our PIM platform, closely integrated with our e-Business ecosystem. We are looking for a Senior Developer for the PIM platform and its surrounding solutions.
 
About the job
You will be a hands-on member of our PIM team, building and evolving the solutions that keep product data flowing between Inriver and the systems around it. You will work closely with product data managers, architects and business stakeholders, from the first discussion about a need into a solution running in production.
 
Key responsibilities:
Design, build and maintain custom extensions and integrations for Inriver in C# / .NET.
Develop and consume REST APIs and integrate Inriver with surrounding systems, such as ERP, web, digital asset management and channel/syndication solutions.
Model and improve our product data structures together with the business.
Troubleshoot data and integration issues and improve the stability and performance of the platform.
Write testable code, take part in code reviews and contribute to our CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.
Refine requirements together with stakeholders and help shape what we build next.
Share your knowledge, document what you build and help colleagues grow.

 
This role is based in Lund, Sweden, and follows a hybrid working model with a minimum of three days per week in the office.
 
Who are you
A senior developer who enjoys the mix of technology and data. You like to understand the problem before you write the solution, you speak up when something can be done better, and you take ownership from idea to production. You are comfortable working independently and just as comfortable in a team that moves fast and keeps a tight agile rhythm.
 
What you know
Must have
Solid professional experience as a developer with strong skills in C# and .NET
Experience building and consuming REST APIs and integrations between systems
Experience with Git, automated tests and CI/CD
Good understanding of software design principles and clean, maintainable code
Good communication skills in English, written and spoken

Strong advantage
Hands-on experience with Inriver (e.g. extensions, the Remoting/REST APIs, data model, Enrich/Syndicate) or another PIM/MDM platform
Experience with cloud platforms, such as serverless functions, message queues and secrets management
Experience with data integration, ETL or message-based architecture
Experience from product data, e-commerce or manufacturing environments

No Inriver experience? If you are a strong .NET developer with integration experience and curious about product data, we will teach you the platform. Experience from agentic coding is a plus.
 
What we offer
Team. A close-knit, experienced team with a good pace and a pragmatic, agile way of working.
Purpose. Pioneering positive impact is not a slogan on a wall here. Our customers use our solutions to save energy, clean water and make food and medicine available to more people.
Stability. Alfa Laval is a listed company with more than 140 years of history, present in around 100 countries. We think long term, invest steadily in technology and do not chase hype. You can build something here and see it last.
Growth. Real influence over technical choices, and time to learn: onboarding on Inriver and our product data landscape, plus room for your own development.

 
We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.
We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
 
 
At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund or have an established presence in the area.
 
Our commitment to integrity
We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.
 
As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.

Are you passionate about beer, quality, and production processes? Do you want to be a key player in packaging our award-winning beers? Then you might be our next Team Leader!
Omnipollo AB is a Swedish brewery founded in 2010 by brewer Henok Fentie and designer Karl Grandin. Over the years, the brewery has won numerous awards for its beer and has several bestsellers such as Levon, Nebuchadnezzar, and Noa Pecan Mud Cake. Omnipollo AB exports its beer to 45 countries. Omnipollo AB has a number of restaurants and bars including Omnipollos hatt and Omnipollos kyrka in Stockholm as well as Omnipollos Tokyo in Japan.
About the Role
As a Team Leader at our packaging facility in Kungsängen, you will play a central role in leading and distributing the daily work. Your main responsibility is to ensure that the daily operations including tanking, centrifugation, pasteurization, packaging, and ongoing equipment maintenance run efficiently and correctly. You will work closely with the Head of Production, the production team at the brewery, and the Warehouse Manager. You will coach, lead, and coordinate the Packaging Operators to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow. Together with your colleagues, you will take responsibility for creating a good working environment and developing our operations. The work requires precision to maintain our routines, industry standards, and to produce products of high quality that meet all statutory requirements.
Your Responsibilities:
Leading and overseeing the daily operational work at the packaging facility to ensure efficient and smooth processes.
Coaching and leading Packaging Operators, ensuring their work follows company guidelines and industry standards.
Performing ongoing floor maintenance and planning to minimize production downtime, as well as acting as the main contact for technical repairs (welders, plumbers, electricians, etc.).
Assisting in staff schedule planning in collaboration with the Head of Production.
Acting as a supervisor and mentor for new staff and interns.
Ensuring routines and SOPs are followed in daily work and actively contributing to their development.

As well as being a part of the daily operations:
Operating centrifugation and pasteurization.
Packaging our products.
Logging and documenting work.
Transferring beer out of the brewery and into the packaging facility.
Performing cleaning and CIP (Clean in Place).

Who Are You?
We are looking for someone who has a strong interest in production processes and a natural aptitude for leadership. You are a problem solver who can quickly identify and resolve practical or technical issues that may arise during the packaging and brewing process. You have a desire to motivate a team of brewery workers, delegate tasks effectively, and ensure excellent communication within the group. To succeed in this role, you also need to be competent in performing taste and quality tests to ensure our products meet company standards, and be committed to ensuring the team complies with all food, safety and statutory guidelines.
Qualifications:
Brewery technician education or equivalent.
Minimum 4 years of experience working in packaging at a brewery. 
Experience in a leading or coordinating role with an emphasis on technical aspects is highly meriting.
Solid expertise regarding packaging equipment, centrifugal separators, pasteurizers, the brewing process, and the finished product.
Technical skills to handle and maintain brewery equipment.
Valid B driver’s license and forklift license (Truckkort).
Fluent in English both spoken and written; Swedish is a huge plus.

About the Employment
The position is full-time with an initial six-month probationary period. You will work closely with the team, as well as our brewery and bars.
We believe in warmth, professionalism, and the idea that everyone should feel at home with us. Our reach is global, but our heart is rooted locally. It is our community and collaboration that make us so successful. Want to join us on our journey?
Send your application marked “Packaging Team leader” to jobs@omnipollo.com. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so the position may be filled before the closing date.
Welcome with your application - and thank you very much for your interest!
We try to respond to everyone who applies to us, but sometimes we must prioritize operational activities and cannot get to all administrative tasks. So if you haven't heard from us within two weeks, we have moved forward with other candidates.

Stratsys and Hypergene are now one organisation, serving customers across the Nordics with solutions for Financial planning, Performance Management, GRC, Sustainability and Quality. We are now looking for a Web & Digital Optimization Manager to join the Hypergene Group in Stockholm.
This is an exciting opportunity to take on a role with clear ownership and real influence during a time of change. You will take overall ownership of our new shared website and its digital effectiveness – from a technical, visual and commercial perspective – while playing a central role in shaping how our digital presence develops as Stratsys and Hypergene come together.
Read more about the Stratsys and Hypergene merger here: https://www.stratsys.com/news-blog/hypergene-stratsys-officially-join-forces

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? 💡

Join Hypergene Group at an exciting stage and play a key role in developing a shared digital presence for two established SaaS companies.

Take ownership of an area that is becoming increasingly strategic and commercially important.

Have the mandate and space to identify opportunities, set direction and make a tangible impact.

Collaborate with an ambitious and close-knit Marketing team across Demand Generation, Brand, Content, Design and Lifecycle Marketing.

Work closely with external web and performance marketing agencies, as well as colleagues across the wider business.

Work from our central Stockholm office and be part of a social, ambitious and collaborative team.

ABOUT THE ROLE 📌
As Web & Digital Optimization Manager, you will have a key role in developing how our website and wider digital presence support the customer journey and commercial objectives across Hypergene Group.
Website strategy and performance
You will define how our website should evolve across markets, languages and stages of the buying journey. This includes owning key performance metrics for traffic, engagement and lead conversion, and using data and user behaviour to identify, prioritise and drive the initiatives that create the greatest impact.
Conversion optimisation
You will drive structured CRO initiatives to continuously improve how visitors engage with our digital presence. Working closely with Demand Generation and Lifecycle Marketing, you will develop and optimise landing pages, forms, CTAs and user journeys.
Findability and digital visibility
As the way people search for and evaluate solutions continues to change, you will develop our approach to technical and on-page SEO, AEO/GEO and LLM findability. You will also strengthen our presence across relevant third-party channels, such as G2, Reddit and review platforms, ensuring that Hypergene Group is visible and accurately represented where future customers seek information.
Governance and delivery
You will create structure around our web operations, including CMS governance, publishing processes, quality standards, GDPR compliance, cookie consent and tracking. Together with internal stakeholders and external web and performance agencies, you will set direction, prioritise initiatives and align Marketing, Brand, Content and Design around a shared web roadmap and future digital platform. 

YOUR BACKGROUND ✔️

5+ years in web, digital optimisation or growth within B2B SaaS.

Proven CRO results, with experience running tests and using data to prove impact.

Strong technical SEO skills and hands-on experience with tools like Ahrefs and GA4.

A practical understanding of how AI and LLMs are changing search.

Proven ability to use AI in day-to-day work, with concrete examples of workflows or agents you have built or run.

Working knowledge of GDPR and cookie consent on websites.

Experience with a CMS like Webflow and Hubspot, and with managing external agencies.

Fluent English and preferably good Swedish, with the ability to quality-assure Swedish content

ABOUT YOU 👀
You are structured, proactive and commercially minded, with strong project management skills and the confidence to take ownership. You can see the bigger picture of how digital presence should support a business, while also translating it into clear priorities and practical next steps.
You are comfortable setting direction, asking the right questions and balancing different perspectives. At the same time, you enjoy working closely with colleagues and partners to bring people together around a shared direction. Curiosity about digital behaviour and a genuine interest in shaping what comes next are key to succeeding in this role.

WHERE YOU FIT 📍
You will report to the Head of Demand & Revenue Marketing and join a close-knit, ambitious Marketing team spanning Demand Generation, Brand, Content, Design and Lifecycle Marketing. You will work from our central Stockholm office.

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

 Your role

Do you want to develop security at one of Sweden's most high-tech companies? Security is prioritized, on top management's agenda and crucial for competitiveness, profitability and trust on a challenging global market. Saab Naval Security Department is looking for a Head of Security Operations.
 
As Head of Security Operations, you are a manager with personnel responsibility, and report directly to Head of Security at the business area (BA) Naval. You will work in an international environment where advanced security threats are part of everyday business alongside complex business environments and projects with high business impact.
 
In the role as Head of Security Operations, you are highly operational but should also feel a tactical responsibility to build and strengthen a general security culture within the BA. You will develop security practices to meet both external and internal security protection requirements.
 
You will work closely with the entire Security Department, but in particular with Business Unit (BU) Security, Supply Chain Security and Security Office at Saab Naval.
 
Your main tasks will be:
Coordinating security through all the BU Security and be the contact person for all security issues
Leading security protection planning according to all the BU contracts that require security protection
Leading and ensuring regulatory compliance, such as continuously reviewing and evaluating applicable laws, regulations, requirements and agreements for the BU related to security protection
Being the bridge between the Security Officers in your organization and Head of Security in security-related matters

 
You will liaise and collaborate extensively internally and externally.
 
Business Area Naval provides the most efficient platforms on and under the sea, both for the military and civilian domain. The portfolio covers submarines, surface ships, combat boats, under- surface vessels, torpedoes and more.
 
Within Saab Security, we have anchored a Saab wide ambition to become world leading in security risk management and to be referred to by other security professionals as the company having the best practices in place.
 

Your profile

 
Required skills:
Documented experience from leading teams, personnel responsibility
Documented experience in Swedish Security Protection Act
Good communication skills in Swedish and English, verbal and written
Several years of experience from working with security related legislation and legal frameworks

 
Desired skills:
Several years of experience of working for government authorities or in a global company, including an understanding of security related issues in the business process
Leadership/management experience
Experience from and an ability to build and maintain networks and good relations inside as well as outside your own organization

 
You are a true team player, and as such you focus on team results.
Personal qualities will be of the outmost importance, and it is paramount that you are trustworthy with strong ethics and personal integrity.
 
You understand the need for balanced security in a business-driven environment. As an Information Security Officer at Saab Kockums, you are likely to get in contact with classified information. This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.
 

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
 
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
 
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. Our complex cable installations, both offshore and onshore, utilize the latest technology to ensure quality and efficiency.  Your CV should also include:

Electronics Design Engineer – MedTech
Location: Gothenburg area, Sweden
Employment: Full-time
Industry: MedTech / Medical Devices
Are you an Electronics Design Engineer looking to develop technology that makes a real difference?
We are looking for an experienced Electronics Design Engineer to join a MedTech product development team working with advanced medical devices.
In this role, you will be involved throughout the product development lifecycle – from concept, specification and architecture through design, prototyping and testing to manufacturing transfer and product support.
You will work in a highly regulated environment where technical excellence, quality, safety and reliability are critical. The role offers the opportunity to influence technical solutions and contribute to the development of products used in healthcare.
The Role
As an Electronics Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical design and development of electrical hardware for new products as well as improvements to existing products.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams, development partners, manufacturing, suppliers and other stakeholders to ensure that electrical designs meet technical, quality and regulatory requirements.
You will also have the opportunity to investigate new technologies and propose innovative technical solutions that address customer and product needs.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and design electrical and electronic hardware for new and existing medical products.
Participate in the complete product development lifecycle, including:
Concept development
Requirements and specifications
System and hardware architecture
Component selection
Circuit design
Prototyping
Testing and verification
Risk analysis
Manufacturing transfer
Service and product support
Plan, coordinate and execute electrical hardware development activities within projects and sub-projects.
Ensure appropriate design controls and documentation according to requirements.
Participate in technical reviews and contribute to engineering decisions.
Coordinate technical activities with development and manufacturing partners.

Hardware testing and verification

Securitas Risk Intelligence delivers actionable intelligence on the global security and threat landscape, creating decision-making advantage and confidence to protect people, property, and assets. As part of Securitas' intelligence-led approach to security, we combine data- and tech-driven insights with expert human analysis to deliver risk intelligence that is accurate, timely, relevant, and actionable.
About the role
Reporting to the CFO of Security Risk Management (SRM) and being part of SRI Leadership Team - the Finance Business Partner owns business controlling and performance management for SRI and acts as the finance business partner to VP SRI. The role will make SRI’s economics more visible and actionable, while establishing a more rigorous, forward-looking and technology-enabled approach to commercial, financial and operational performance. The role will be collaborating with dedicated financial control and financial shared service.
SRI needs stronger dedicated financial ownership and deeper performance insight. The role will improve the speed and quality of decisions, strengthen adherence to the financial model, raise the quality of business cases and create systematic follow-up on expected benefits, supporting sustainable and profitable growth.
Responsibilities

Business partnering and decision support: Act as the day-to-day finance partner to VP SRI and SRI leadership. Translate commercial and operational choices into financial implications, alternatives and recommendations. Challenge assumptions constructively and maintain an independent finance perspective.

Performance management: Own the SRI performance view across commercial performance, financial results, operational drivers and forward-looking indicators. Explain underlying causes, identify risks and opportunities early, and convert analysis into clear actions and follow-up. Runs the recurring business reviews.

Planning and forecasting: Own the SRI business-planning cycle, including budget, forecasts and longer-term outlook. Drive timelines, assumptions, quality and consistency with the agreed financial model. Ensure forecasts are robust, evidence-based and action-oriented.

Business cases and benefits tracking: Strengthen the quality and consistency of investment and commercial business cases. Test assumptions, quantify scenarios and risks, and establish disciplined post-decision follow-up against expected outcomes.

Reporting, data and automation: Improve data structures, definitions and controls. Use automation and AI where they materially improve speed, quality, scalability or insight.

Finance team collaboration: Work closely with the SRI Financial Controller, setting priorities for reporting, analysis and finance support. Leverage the Controller's ownership of financial control, data integrity and recurring processes to enable stronger performance management and business decision support.

Support to SRM: While the primary focus is on SRI, the role will provide targeted analytical and ad-hoc support to the CFO of SRM and contribute to broader SRM performance-management priorities and develop towards a wider remit over time.

Requirements
Candidate profile

Analytical strength: analytical ability and data literacy. Able to structure ambiguous questions, reconcile conflicting information, identify root causes and form evidence-based conclusions.

Finance foundation: Grounding in business controlling, performance management, financial planning, modelling and business cases. Connecting operational drivers to P&L impact.

Commercial judgement: Understands that finance exists to improve decisions, not only to report results. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders while remaining pragmatic.

Learning agility and potential: Learns unfamiliar businesses quickly, actively seeks responsibility, forms independent views and demonstrates clear capacity to grow into a broader role.

Technology mindset: Curiosity about data, systems, automation and AI. Looks for scalable ways to improve finance processes and insight.

Communication: Able to explain conclusions clearly and focus stakeholders on what matters. Executive polish is desirable but can be developed. Fluency in English.

Indicative experience

Experience in business controlling, FP&A, performance management, transaction services, consulting, revenue operations or a comparable analytical finance role.

Demonstrated ownership of complex analysis, planning or business-case work, not only production of recurring reports.

Experience working with/presenting to senior business stakeholders.

Evidence of improving a process, analysis or decision workflow through better use of data, systems, automation or AI.

University degree in finance, economics, engineering, data or a comparable discipline.

Personal characteristics

Curious and willing to investigate until the underlying logic is understood.

Independent in judgement and effective in a collaborative environment.

High ownership and pace, with the discipline to finish and follow through.

Comfortable moving between detailed analysis and broader commercial implications.

Ambitious to grow and motivated by building capability and improving the business.

Working conditions
The role is based in Stockholm and involves occasional travelling.
Hybrid model applies (with 3 days in the office per week).
If this sounds like the right next step in your career, don't hesitate and apply!

jobs.occupation: Project Controls Performance and Reporting Lead
jobs.description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.
If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.
At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.
Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.
What you’ll do
As the Project Controls Performance and Reporting Lead for Green Steel, you’ll bring together project information from Planning, Cost, Contracts, the EPCM contractor and other area teams. You’ll analyse this information to show how the project is performing, highlight trends and deviations, and provide clear reporting and recommendations to support decision-making.
Coordinate the collection, validation and integration of cost, contract, schedule, progress, quantity and resource information.
Analyse performance data to identify trends, variances, risks, opportunities and issues requiring action.
Prepare consolidated reports, dashboards and management summaries for the area.
Work with project teams and the EPCM contractor to align inputs and resolve gaps or discrepancies in reporting.
Follow up significant differences between reported progress and site execution, escalating issues where needed.
Support consistent project controls processes and reporting standards within the area.
Identify practical improvements to reporting, data quality and analysis, including opportunities to use automation and Power BI.
Provide technical guidance on integrated reporting and performance analysis, and support project reviews and assurance activities.

What you’ll bring
You’re analytical and comfortable working across different project disciplines. You can bring complex project information together, identify what it means for performance, and explain your findings clearly to different stakeholders.
Relevant experience in project controls, cost control, contract or commercial controls, or project performance reporting in a complex project environment.
Experience consolidating and analysing information across areas such as cost, schedule, progress, contracts, quantities or resources.
Experience working with EPCM contractors and multidisciplinary project teams.
Strong skills in trend and variance analysis, forecasting, progress measurement, and identifying risks and opportunities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI and relevant project controls systems.
Knowledge of project controls governance and practices such as AACE or PMI.
Ability to turn complex data into clear reports, insights and recommendations.
Professional written and verbal communication skills in English.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. A project controls or cost management certification is an advantage.

Benefits at Stegra
At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.
You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.
This is Stegra
Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.
By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

jobs.occupation: Learning Design Consultant – Retail Sales Academy
jobs.description:
Your New Role 
We’re looking for an experienced learning design consultant to help our client build a global Retail Sales Academy.
You’ll translate an established sales job architecture and skills framework into role- and skill-based learning journeys for four profiles: Commercial Management, Account Management, Field Sales and Sales Enablement. The Academy will be delivered through the client’s Learning Experience Platform (LXP) and will support onboarding and ongoing development for approximately 1,500 employees across more than 20 markets.
You’ll start by identifying which existing resources can be reused or adapted. You’ll then build learning paths that give employees a clear progression, opportunities to practice in real sales situations, and support from managers and peers. English will be the master language, with local-language content where it helps employees apply what they learn. Spanish-language needs will be a particular focus as you design for rollout across Europe, North America and Latin America.
What you’ll do

Define the Academy’s structure, curriculum and learner navigation, including who will own and maintain it after launch.

Review internal and third-party learning content and map relevant resources to priority roles, skills and proficiency levels.

Design learning journeys with clear outcomes, a logical sequence, hands-on activities, manager coaching and peer learning.

Identify priority content gaps and adapt or develop materials where existing resources fall short.

Define a scalable localization approach, including how translated and adapted content will be quality-checked and maintained.

Prepare learning path specifications, taxonomy and metadata requirements for implementation in the LXP.

Deliver editable assets, documentation and knowledge transfer so the client’s teams can manage and update the Academy after handover.

Company Presentation
Our client is a leading global hygiene and health company operating in around 150 countries under several strong brands. They work to break barriers to well-being, combining innovation with a strong focus on sustainability, diversity, and inclusion. Through their efforts, they create value for customers, consumers, employees, and society at large.
Good to Know
Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters. Start date: As soon as possible. End date: 2027-04-15, with the possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.
To succeed in this role, you will need: 
Strong experience designing corporate academies, structuring curricula and building role- or skill-based learning journeys aligned with business capabilities and proficiency levels.

Experience assessing large third-party learning libraries and selecting content based on quality, relevance and practical application. You know how to reuse and adapt existing resources and create new content where it fills a clear gap.

Experience designing learning for sales or commercial teams, with practical activities, manager coaching, peer learning and follow-up that help employees apply new skills on the job.

Experience with Cornerstone or a comparable enterprise learning platform and the ability to prepare learning paths, taxonomy and metadata for implementation.

Experience supporting learning initiatives across multiple markets and languages, including quality assurance and maintenance of localized content.

Ability to lead the design work independently and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts and learning teams.

Experience delivering implementation-ready specifications, editable assets and clear handover documentation so internal teams can maintain and develop the Academy over time.

What we Offer
Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

Additional compensation during parental leave

Occupational health services

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We look forward to receiving your application 
We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

Lead and shape People Operations at our Rosersberg site - driving operational excellence, employee experience, and strong labor relations in a fast-growing circular economy.
Balance leadership, labour law, and staffing while driving efficient HR processes for Sellpy Operations. From coaching to strategic site development, lead our local HR team and build a safe workplace.
Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We see a tremendous financial, social and environmental value in making sure unused items are put to use again. We are looking for colleagues who share this vision, and who are ready to see their work contribute to a sustainable future.
HR Manager Interim, at Sellpy
We’re looking for a grounded, operational HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced logistics environment and is passionate about driving a modern, proactive People Operations function. In this interim role, you will take full ownership of leading and developing our local HR function at the site in Rosersberg. You will act as a trusted advisor to our Site Manager and local management, ensuring our site meets staffing targets while fostering a safe, empowered, and sustainable work environment.
You will dive into labor law - specifically Lager- och e-handelsavtalet - manage union relations, and streamline everything from recruitment to on- and offboarding journeys. Together with the site management, you'll balance day-to-day coaching with continuous improvement projects that boost site performance and scalability.
In short, you will
Provide first-line leadership support and coaching to managers across daily employee relations and operational challenges.
Lead, coach, and develop the local HR team at our Rosersberg site. The team consists of one HR Generalist and one Recruiter.
Drive staffing strategies to meet operational targets, balancing direct warehouse recruitment and temporary agency staffing.
Manage labour relations, acting as the primary point of contact for collective bargaining agreements (Lager- och e-handelsavtalet), union collaboration, safety delegates, and occupational health services.
Oversee systematic work environment management (SAM) in close partnership with the Site Manager to ensure a secure and healthy workplace.
Manage authority liaise with relevant agencies and handle work permit applications with Migrationsverket when needed.
Build, optimise, and maintain smooth employee journeys, from onboarding and offboarding to HR system administration and payroll preparations.

We use
Modern HRM and ATS platforms for end-to-end People Operations and recruitment tracking
Google Workspace and collaborative communication tools

Requirements
A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Labor Relations, Behavioral science, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience in an HR Manager role (2+ years) or HRBP role (3+ years) within logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, or a fast-paced operational setting.
Solid working knowledge of Swedish labor law (arbetsrätt) and practical experience with Swedish collective agreements, preferably Lager- och e-handelsavtalet.
Experience leading or mentoring HR team members and collaborating constructively with trade unions and safety representatives.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to balance hands-on operational duties and structured process improvements.
Pragmatic, business-oriented mindset with high personal integrity and communication skills.
Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

We’d be impressed if you have
Experience managing temporary staffing agencies and high-volume blue-collar recruitment.
Worked in a fast-growing, product-focused startup or scale-up environment.
Prior experience handling work permit applications with Migrationsverket.

You get to
Work closely with production and operations, experiencing firsthand the heartbeat of our circular supply chain.
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues.
Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform
Make use of prepaid vacation
Enjoy Sellpy credits and staff discounts at Sellpy
Save up with a monthly pension plan
Engagement in Sellpy’s social traditions with game nights, interactive planning days, guest speakers and other activities

Location
On-site at our warehouse in Rosersberg.
Due to the operational nature of this role and the need to stay closely connected with the warehouse team and managers, you will spend the majority of your time on-site. You will have regular touchpoints and collaboration with our HQ in Stockholm.

Are you specialised in managing, optimising and steering digital channels and websites for maximum performance?
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist to join Adapteo’s Group Marketing & Communications team and take an important role on our exciting growth journey and be a part of our mission to help society thrive in an ever-changing world.
About Adapteo
We’re Northern Europe's leading provider of outstanding, modular spaces for a more flexible, low-carbon future.
Society doesn’t stand still—so infrastructure shouldn’t either. At Adapteo, we develop and provide adaptable modular buildings that can be moved, transformed, and used, again and again to meet the dynamic needs of society sustainably. Through our circular business model, we deliver maximum value with minimal resource usage, catering to the evolving demands of our customers and society. We are poised to become market leaders across all operational regions and to set new standards in social infrastructure and circularity within the built environment.
About the role
As our digital marketing and data expert, you’ll play a key role in shaping and developing Adapteo’s digital ecosystem. You will take ownership of our digital platforms and marketing technology stack, ensuring they continuously evolve to support our business goals and deliver measurable impact.
You will work on group level and closely with our creative and local marketing teams in our European business units.
Your responsibilities:
With a holistic approach, you’ll manage and optimise the entire digital customer journey – from traffic generation and user experience to conversion and performance tracking. You’ll act as the internal go-to expert for MarCom data and our digital platforms, driving improvements, identifying new opportunities, and ensuring a scalable and data-driven approach across markets.
In practice, you’ll cover:
Platform and website maintenance and optimisation: Act as day-to-day platform lead, ensuring digital platforms and tools (HubSpot, GA4) work smoothly and accurately, making hands-on updates as needed.
Website performance: Run upgrade projects to maximise impact – from SEO/SEM and AEO to new website functions – working from briefs to deployment, setting up requirements, managing subcontractors, and ensuring qualitative deliveries.
SoMe management: Work with the global and BU marketing teams to optimise performance and track results on SoMe platforms (Meta, YouTube, Linkedin etc.).
Planning & scoping: Define scope and set up plans for digital optimisation together with our Global Head of Marketing.
Reporting & analytics: Follow up, analyse and report on results versus goals; set up new performance tracking when needed.

Manage projects: Develop new digital tools and functionalities when needed and support BU marketing teams with training and implementation, in close collaboration with our Global Head of Marketing.
Who you are
We believe that you are a strong communicator and collaborator with a hands-on approach. You are driven by developing solutions for improved efficiency, optimised user experience and higher engagement. You are experimental and curious but work in a structured yet agile way, paying close attention to performance and results. You also possess a good understanding of digital architecture and performance, and have the ability to apply this knowledge not only yourself, but also to teach and inspire others to grow in these areas.
We believe that you have:
At least 5 years of proven experience from managing digital platforms and accelerating digital performance.
Inhouse experience in a multinational organisation.
Proficiency in HubSpot, Google Analytics 4 and SoMe channels or similar.
Experience in leading digital projects with multi-stakeholder teams.
Experience in setting up dashboards, track results and take action to optimise forward.
Fluent in English – speaking and writing.
Degree in marketing or similar

Some details
You’ll be based at our HQ in Solna. Adapteo’s operations span across 9 countries in Northern and Central Europe – some travel may be involved.
Application and timeline
If you are excited about joining our team – welcome to apply! Apply by attaching your Linkedin profile (no full CV needed) and put some extra effort into answering the screening questions in the application form.
Our recruitment partner UrbanUrban manages this recruitment. Welcome to contact lead recruiter Frida Kask Rosén (frida@urbanurban.se) for any questions.
The selection process will begin immediately, and recruitment will continue throughout the summer. As a result, response times may be longer than usual. We will keep all candidates informed about the expected timeline and aim to complete the process as soon as we find the right match. We look forward to receiving your application!
